# Pillar & Frame

> A story-led film studio in Ohio for founder-driven service brands. The Trust Engine: real stories captured on film, turned into a content waterfall of videos, captions, newsletters, and quote images, put to work on LinkedIn and Google Business Profiles. Plus systems coaching for the CRM and follow-up businesses already pay for.

## Services
- Founder Launch Kit (Foundations, one-time $5,000): one filming day, then in 30 days your Google Business Profile, social profiles, and website copy are written, shot, and installed for you. Not handed over. https://pillarandframe.com/founder-launch-kit
- The Trust Engine (Retainer, $2,500/mo): after the Launch Kit, we film you once a month and turn it into a month of videos, posts, captions, and graphics in your voice, with coaching built in. https://pillarandframe.com/trust-engine

## Proof
- Case studies: https://pillarandframe.com/work (Frontier Technologies, Memorial Health)
